joshua.title: Joshua AI Agent
joshua.subtitle: AI Copywriting Agent powered by KoGPT-2

overview.summary: AI copy generation service for ad agency copywriters. Keyword input → KoGPT-2 generates ad copy → auto-classified into 4 tones → tone-matched font pairing.
highlights: KoGPT-2 Fine-tuning: trained on ad copy dataset, keyword-based prompt structure design
2-stage generation: batch generation → user selection → refined generation
Tone classification & font matching: 4 tones (emotional/challenge/playful/trust), 12 auto-matched fonts
Electron cross-platform: Windows/macOS simultaneous support, IPC communication architecture
Stripe subscription: web portal-based payment → desktop app integration
GPU bare-metal server: self-hosted infrastructure to cut cloud GPU costs
10-month weekly client meetings (~25 sessions): service architecture, dashboard mockups, deliverables

challenge1.title: Electron IPC Architecture Design
challenge1.problem: Needed to safely synchronize AI inference requests, Stripe payment events, and UI state between Main↔Renderer processes. Direct API calls from Renderer exposed security vulnerabilities (API key exposure) + CORS issues.
challenge1.solution: Main process handles all external communication (FastAPI, Stripe), Renderer is UI-only. ipcMain → FastAPI inference relay, ipcRenderer → RxJS Observable streaming. Stripe webhooks processed in Main → payment state propagated to UI.
challenge1.result: SI project delivered on schedule. Windows/macOS cross-platform desktop app shipped.

challenge2.title: KoGPT-2 Inference Pipeline Optimization
challenge2.problem: Default generation settings produced excessive unnecessary tokens → response latency + quality degradation. Fast response was critical for production use.
challenge2.solution: Keyword-centric prompt structure to focus model context. Experimental top-k/temperature tuning. GPU bare-metal server serving FastAPI inference endpoint.
challenge2.result: Reduced unnecessary token generation, achieved production-grade inference speed. Windows/macOS simultaneous launch.

achievements: KoGPT-2 fine-tuned ad copy generation model
Stripe web payment integration for subscription SaaS

dyCms.title: DY Microfinance ERP
dyCms.subtitle: Myanmar Microfinance Customer Management System

overview.summary: Web-based ERP digitalizing customer/loan/repayment/delinquency management and accounting for a Myanmar microfinance institution. Excel manual work → system migration, 90% accounting automation.
highlights: Loan interest engine: 7/14/28/30-day non-monthly cycles + 3 repayment methods (equal P&I/equal P/bullet) + local currency rounding to 100s
JWT auth + auto-renewal: Next.js Middleware detects Access Token expiry → auto Refresh Token renewal, Redis blacklist logout
RBAC 3 roles: Admin/Officer/Staff — frontend menu filtering + backend API Guard dual protection
Cursor Pagination: Offset 800ms → Cursor 35ms (95% improvement), Infinite Scroll
Dual Caching (L1+L2): In-Memory ~5ms + Redis ~35ms → 70% API response improvement
$12/mo operation: AWS Lightsail ($10) + Vercel (free), Docker Compose, PM2 cluster

challenge1.title: Frontend-Backend Separated Architecture
challenge1.problem: Excel dependency → dozens of hours for month-end closing, frequent data integrity errors. Needed maintainability and scalability under solo development constraints.
challenge1.solution: Next.js App Router + NestJS + PostgreSQL separated architecture. Server Actions for form handling, NestJS module system for domain-separated accounting logic. RBAC 3-role routing.
challenge1.result: ~90% accounting process automation. Month-end closing reduced from dozens of hours to a few hours.

challenge2.title: RBAC + JWT Authentication System
challenge2.problem: Loan officers/accountants/admins have different scopes. Without role-based access control, financial data integrity at risk.
challenge2.solution: JWT with role claim, NestJS Guard decorator for per-API role verification. Next.js middleware route filtering + role-based dashboard layout separation. Frontend + backend dual validation.
challenge2.result: 3-role dual-layer access control securing data integrity. 99.5% uptime over 6+ months.

achievements: 15+ frontend pages, 30+ reusable components, 45+ backend APIs, 14 DB entities

retailAnalysis.title: Retail Store Customer Analysis
retailAnalysis.subtitle: Visual Intelligence-based Real-time Customer Tracking System

overview.summary: On-premise system connecting 4 CCTVs at Malaysia Parkson department store SPAO outlet, tracking customers in real-time with YOLOv7 + StrongSORT to analyze movement paths, dwell time, and congestion.
highlights: YOLOv7 Fine-tuning: additional training on 2,000+ store CCTV frames, mAP 78.2% → 92.4%. 95% reduction in mannequin false positives (ROI masking)
StrongSORT Tracking: OSNet Re-ID + Kalman Filter for persistent customer ID tracking, MOTA 87.3%, ID Switch <50/hr
CCW entry counting: Counter-Clockwise algorithm for entry direction detection, Track ID dedup, 96.2% accuracy
Coordinate transform: 2D Homography mapping CCTV distortion → store floor plan, error <15cm
P1~P13 zone dwell analysis: Shapely Polygon-based customer location classification, popular zone/time-of-day pattern analysis
On-premise server: Ubuntu + RTX 3060, RTSP connection, $0 cloud cost, 99.5% uptime
Real-time dashboard: 6 visualization modes (In/Out, Detection, Tracking, Heatmap %, Heatmap count, Movement), Canvas API, Firebase sync <1s

challenge1.title: Store-specific YOLOv7 Fine-tuning
challenge1.problem: COCO pretrained model misidentified mannequins/posters as people → 95% false positive rate. Store-specific fine-tuning required.
challenge1.solution: Additional training on 2,000+ store CCTV frames + ROI masking to exclude mannequin-dense zones. mAP 78.2% → 92.4%.
challenge1.result: 95% reduction in mannequin false positives. Capable of analyzing 3,000+ customers daily.

challenge2.title: VanillaJS Real-time Dashboard
challenge2.problem: High-performance rendering requirements: per-second data refresh + Canvas/SVG heatmaps + WebSocket streaming simultaneously.
challenge2.solution: Observer pattern state management + requestAnimationFrame 60fps target + Debouncing for WebSocket event throttling. Chart.js for statistical charts.
challenge2.result: 6-mode real-time visualization dashboard enabling store layout optimization and product placement strategy.

achievements: Detection mAP 92.4%, Tracking MOTA 87.3%, Entry counting 96.2%

scholarlyChain.title: Scholarly Chain
scholarlyChain.subtitle: Hyperledger Fabric Blockchain Student Fee Management

overview.summary: Capstone design project recording student fee income/expenses on Hyperledger Fabric blockchain for transparency. 3-role access control: student/committee/admin.
highlights: JWT auto-renewal middleware: Next.js Middleware auto-refreshes via Refresh Token on approaching expiry → prevents session disconnection
FCM role-based push: Firestore stores FCM tokens by role, targeted multicast (deposit confirmation → committee, vote results → students)
Context API role-based UI: JWT decode → role extraction → useUser() hook for global role management, conditional rendering
API Route proxy: Next.js API Routes relay to backend, server-side cookie → Authorization header auto-attach, CORS resolved
15+ pages, 30+ reusable components, shadcn/ui design system

challenge1.title: JWT Auto-Renewal Middleware Design
challenge1.problem: Blockchain transaction verification requires long sessions, but JWT expiry causes session disconnection → UX degradation. Vercel serverless prevents session-based auth.
challenge1.solution: Next.js middleware checks JWT expiry on every request → auto-refreshes within threshold via Refresh Token. API Routes proxy to blockchain backend, role-based route guards applied.
challenge1.result: 3-role auth system with zero session disconnection. 15+ pages, 30+ components deployed on Vercel.

challenge2.title: Blockchain Integration Proxy Architecture
challenge2.problem: Direct Hyperledger SDK calls from frontend would expose certificates/network config → security risk + bundle size increase.
challenge2.solution: Next.js API Routes as proxy. Frontend → API Routes → blockchain backend relay. FCM push integration, shadcn/ui transaction history visualization.
challenge2.result: Complete elimination of blockchain SDK dependencies from frontend. Transparency dashboard built.

dinoGo.title: Dino Go
dinoGo.subtitle: Sui Blockchain Location-based NFT Collection Game

overview.summary: Sui blockchain game where players collect dinosaur NFTs by visiting real locations. Checkpoint visit → on-chain random alphabet → sentence NFT minting → Kiosk marketplace trading.
highlights: On-Chain Random: sui::random API for cryptographically fair alphabet distribution, epoch-based dedup prevention
Atomic NFT Minting: inventory check → alphabet consumption → NFT minting in single atomic transaction, rollback on failure
Walrus decentralized storage: 90% cost reduction vs on-chain, blob_id metadata embedding
Seal threshold encryption: GPS spoofing prevention, distributed key server threshold decryption, Google Maps API key protection
Escrow marketplace: smart contract escrow, atomic exchange, 2.5% fee auto-distribution, Sui Kiosk compatible
Move smart contracts 4 modules: user, checkpoint, nft, marketplace
3 custom Web3 clients: Walrus/Seal/Kiosk SDK abstraction layer

challenge1.title: Google Maps + Three.js Coordinate Synchronization
challenge1.problem: Google Maps lat/lng coordinate system and Three.js 3D world coordinate system are entirely different. 3D dinosaur objects must follow accurate positions during drag/zoom.
challenge1.solution: OverlayView API extension → Three.js Scene mounted as transparent Canvas overlay. Lat/lng → pixel → 3D world coordinate transform function, dynamic scale adjustment by zoom level.
challenge1.result: Coordinate synchronization system with accurate 3D object positioning during map drag/zoom.

challenge2.title: Web3 Client Library Abstraction
challenge2.problem: Sui SDK, Walrus, Seal, Kiosk SDK each have different interfaces and inconsistent wallet connection/transaction signing patterns → code complexity explosion.
challenge2.solution: 3 custom client libraries with unified connect()/signAndExecute()/upload() interface. Walrus=NFT image distributed storage, Seal=metadata encryption, Kiosk=marketplace transaction encapsulation.
challenge2.result: Consistent Web3 interface calls across 10+ pages. NFT minting + marketplace + distributed storage delivered in 3 days.

achievements: Seal threshold encryption for GPS spoofing prevention
Walrus storage: 90% cost reduction vs on-chain

artWar.title: Ministry of Truth
artWar.subtitle: AI Autonomous Agent Art Tournament Platform

overview.summary: AI art tournament autonomously operated by AI agents. MC agent hosts, AI artists submit, 2 AI judges score, spectators bet on Monad blockchain.
highlights: 3 multi-agent types: MC (host), Judge A (technical aesthetics), Judge B (thematic consistency) — OpenClaw framework, 24/7 autonomous operation
6-phase round state machine: topic → submission → betting → judging → results → preview, timer + participant action-based auto-transition
LLM cost optimization: Kimi (free) → Gemini Flash fallback, vision model capped at 1/round
Solidity betting contract: openRound/placeBet/closeBetting/resolveRound/claimWinnings, 5% fee
nad.fun $MOT token launch + Monad mainnet deployment
NestJS backend + Next.js frontend 5 pages + AWS EC2 agent operations

challenge1.title: LLM Cost-Optimized Multi-Agent Design
challenge1.problem: 3 agent types running 24/7 autonomously risks LLM API cost explosion. Vision models (image critique) are significantly more expensive than text.
challenge1.solution: MC Agent: Kimi (free credits) → Gemini Flash fallback priority chain. Judge A/B: vision model capped at 1 call/round. NestJS tracks per-agent call counts.
challenge1.result: Minimized LLM API costs across 1 week of 24/7 autonomous operation. Quarterfinals → semifinals → finals fully autonomous.

challenge2.title: 6-Phase Autonomous Round State Machine
challenge2.problem: 6 phases (topic → submission → betting → judging → results → preview) must auto-progress via timer + participant actions. Single phase failure risks halting entire round.
challenge2.solution: NestJS state machine pattern. 6 phase enums + auto-transition on completion criteria (timer OR action). MC generates topics → posts → sets timer, Judges score → post results, betting settlement auto-executes in results phase.
challenge2.result: Quarterfinals → semifinals → finals run fully autonomously without human intervention. Judge A (technique 40% + color 30% + interpretation 20% + emotion 10%) + Judge B (technique 10% + color 20% + interpretation 30% + emotion 40%).

challenge3.title: Solidity On-chain Betting System
challenge3.problem: Betting result distribution must be transparent, automated, and manipulation-proof. ArtWar-specific round lifecycle contract needed.
challenge3.solution: ArtWarBetting.sol in Solidity 0.8.20. openRound → placeBet → closeBetting → resolveRound → claimWinnings 5-phase on-chain management, 5% fee structure.
challenge3.result: Monad mainnet deployment, nad.fun $MOT token launch. Full betting → settlement → claim flow handled transparently on-chain.

achievements: 6-phase state machine for fully autonomous tournament
Solidity betting contract deployed on Monad mainnet

manufacturing.title: Manufacturing Defect Detection
manufacturing.subtitle: Indonesia Shoe Factory Video-based Defect Detection System
manufacturing.role: Equipment Design/Build + AI Model + On-site Installation

overview.summary: Video-based defect detection system directly installed on an Indonesian shoe factory production line. Inspection equipment design/build → OAK-D 3D camera → YOLOv7 defect detection → L/R comparison algorithm.
highlights: OAK-D 3D multi-camera: front+back simultaneous capture, 1280x720, MxId-based device identification, Firebase Storage real-time upload
YOLOv7 custom training: defect detection model trained on factory floor images, FP16 Half Precision + AMP optimization
L/R comparison algorithm: background removal → left image flip → ORB Feature + Homography alignment → 100x100 window Cosine similarity → catches defects DL misses
Anomalib anomaly detection: unsupervised learning from normal samples only, ISR 2x upscaling, window-based anomaly region detection
Inspection equipment designed/built in-house → installed on-site in Indonesia

challenge1.title: DL + Rule-based Hybrid Defect Detection
challenge1.problem: DL alone cannot detect defect types absent from training data. Manufacturing environment has variable lighting, vibration, and conveyor speed.
challenge1.solution: YOLOv7 for trained defect patterns + Rule-based L/R comparison for untrained defects. ORB Feature + Homography alignment → 100x100 window Cosine similarity scoring.
challenge1.result: Hybrid system detecting manufacturing inconsistencies regardless of training data availability.

challenge2.title: OAK-D 3D Camera Multi-stream Capture
challenge2.problem: Standard webcams are 2D only, multi-camera sync difficult. Real-time remote monitoring needed.
challenge2.solution: DepthAI OAK-D for simultaneous front+back capture. MxId-based device identification, Firebase Storage real-time upload for remote monitoring.
challenge2.result: Dual camera simultaneous capture + real-time remote monitoring system established.

achievements: Inspection equipment designed/built + installed on-site in Indonesia
Rule-based L/R comparison: Cosine similarity-based defect scoring

fsiAi.title: Financial Consulting AI
fsiAi.subtitle: Real-time Voice Financial Consulting AI System

overview.summary: Customer call → real-time STT → GPT-4 financial consulting response → TTS voice synthesis → delivered to customer. Won FSI AIxData Challenge 2024 Excellence Award.
highlights: Async voice pipeline: asyncio parallel processing for simultaneous voice reception, STT conversion, AI response, TTS synthesis → minimum latency
Twilio ↔ Server ↔ Returnzero WebSocket streaming
Prompt injection defense: 80+ banned command/keyword list, real-time user input detection → instant block + warning
Conversation context retention: system prompt + user messages + AI response history accumulated → full context included in GPT-4 calls
Audio format compatibility: Twilio 8kHz MULAW → Returnzero MULAW direct support, zero conversion overhead

challenge1.title: Real-time Voice Async Pipeline
challenge1.problem: Sequential STT → AI → TTS processing causes cumulative latency. Voice is more latency-sensitive than text.
challenge1.solution: asyncio for parallel voice reception/STT/AI response/TTS synthesis. Twilio ↔ aiohttp server ↔ Returnzero WebSocket streaming architecture.
challenge1.result: Minimized cumulative latency. Natural real-time voice consulting flow achieved.

challenge2.title: Financial Security — Prompt Injection Defense
challenge2.problem: Malicious prompts risk AI executing system commands or leaking sensitive information. Financial sector security requirements mandatory.
challenge2.solution: 80+ banned command/keyword list-based real-time filtering. User input detection → instant block + warning message return.
challenge2.result: Real-time blocking of system commands and attack keywords. Won FSI AIxData Challenge 2024 Excellence Award.

achievements: FSI AIxData Challenge 2024 Excellence Award (Financial Security Institute)
GPT-4 + Returnzero STT + ElevenLabs TTS integration
